premises.text: There is a growing number of connected devices that can be utilized for data display.
premises.evidence_span: Recent market research says six billion connected things will be in use till the end of this year.

premises.text: People use multiple apps to manage their digital lives.
premises.evidence_span: I personally use more than 50 different apps to manage my digital life.

premises.text: A wall clock can provide a better way to communicate with technology.
premises.evidence_span: There should be a nicer way to communicate with technology rather than checking your phone every single minute.

premises.text: Glenn's clock can display information from wearables and connected devices.
premises.evidence_span: Glenn's clock is a well-designed wall clock with embedded glanceable display, building speaker and open cloud platform.

premises.text: Information can be displayed in a glanceable format without distraction.
premises.evidence_span: It allows you to read information quickly at the glance without being distracted from your current tasks.

premises.text: The cloud platform can integrate with various apps via open APIs.
premises.evidence_span: we have a cloud platform with a lot of integrations that can actually integrate via open APIs.

premises.text: Different clocks can display different data relevant to their location.
premises.evidence_span: it will display different data but always relevant for particular place and the situation.

premises.text: The clock can automatically set the current time when paired with a phone.
premises.evidence_span: you just need to pair your phone with the clock and it will set up current time automatically.

premises.text: The product will be launched through a crowdfunding campaign.
premises.evidence_span: To introduce Glenn's clock to market we will launch Indiegogo campaign on February this year.

premises.text: The product will be available in different designs to suit personal preferences.
premises.evidence_span: we will provide different frames to make it more personal and looks good for your office or your home.

value.text: Users can manage their digital lives more effectively with a smart wall clock.
value.evidence_span: There should be a nicer way to communicate with technology rather than checking your phone every single minute.

notes: Pre-orders and raffle details excluded as traction.
